model_scope: Phase-1 normalized engineering scenarios. All values are deliberately uncalibrated and support conditional design comparisons only.

parameter_basis.input.ligand_normalized: Dimensionless dose axis. It is not an ascr molar concentration, docking score, or affinity estimate.
parameter_basis.receptor.half_activation_normalized: scenario_prior; project Gpr-ascr half activation requires same-chassis dose-response calibration.
parameter_basis.g_protein.coupling_rate_per_hour: wet-lab required for the project chimera; values form an exploratory effective-rate range.
parameter_basis.gal_output.leak_rate: wet-lab required; values represent arbitrary normalized background production rates.
parameter_basis.gal_output.copy_number: 1 is the single-integration design baseline; 2 and 4 are engineering scenarios, not confirmed constructs.
parameter_basis.gal_output.gain_rate: wet-lab required; values explore reporter-layer gain without transferring a value from another biosensor.
parameter_basis.time.duration_hours: Scenario observation windows, not a measured color-development time.

scans.purpose: Show conditional dose-response shapes under alternative normalized receptor half-activation assumptions.
Identify conditional loss of separation when effective receptor-G protein coupling is low or reporter background is high.
Compare 1/2/4-copy engineering scenarios across reporter gain and observation-window assumptions.
